threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie when they wait for the green man at pedestrian crossings, even when no cars are coming.
Caught a group of lads on the 333 re-enacting a famous scene from a film, but it was 'The Inbetweeners' and they were way too into it. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting on a bus, I overheard a kid arguing with his mom about whether to wear a hoodie or not—classic Neukölln weather indecision.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you catch a bus that runs on a Sunday, despite a major strike looming. It’s a chaotic miracle that keeps us on our toes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they casually dodge the BART delays—only tourists look up at the schedule in despair.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 38 Geary pull out a tiny portable speaker and start a karaoke party. Everyone was momentarily confused, then they all sang along.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists snap photos of street performers but rarely notice the real artists—the old men in Plaça de la Vila discussing politics over coffee.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they keep asking for 'tapas' at every meal, not realizing it's a snack and not a full meal here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think Dalston Junction is a train station and not just a place to grab a coffee and contemplate life.
Last night on the 137, a guy serenaded the whole bus with an acoustic guitar. A few passengers recorded it, but most just smiled and hummed along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the man playing guitar outside the Spätkauf didn’t miss a beat as a tram pulled up, and the kids kept dancing like it was just another Saturday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the random street musicians at U-Bahn stations? Some play for coins, others pull out full concerts. It's like a free festival underground.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You notice how only the locals know to dodge the BART delays by hopping on a 22 Fillmore without checking the schedule? That's the tell.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 26 Valencia bus trying to pay with a half-eaten burrito. The driver just shook his head and kept moving. Classic Mission moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals drink vermut at the same hour, but really, it’s just us Graciencs savoring it in secret, tucked away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by how they hesitate at crosswalks, expecting the green man to mean something here. Locals zoom right past.
